Super Rare.name: Barrel Dragon
Super Rare.desc: Once per turn: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; toss a coin 3 times and destroy it if at least 2 of the results are heads.

Super Rare.name: Buster Blader
Super Rare.desc: Gains 500 ATK for each Dragon monster your opponent controls or is in their GY.

Super Rare.name: Thousand-Eyes Restrict
Super Rare.desc:
"Relinquished" + "Thousand-Eyes Idol"
Other monsters on the field cannot change their battle positions or attack. Once per turn: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; equip that target to this card (max. 1). This card's ATK/DEF become equal to that equipped monster's. If this card would be destroyed by battle, destroy that equipped monster instead.

Super Rare.name: Time Wizard
Super Rare.desc: Once per turn: You can toss a coin and call it. If you call it right, destroy all monsters your opponent controls. If you call it wrong, destroy as many monsters you control as possible, and if you do, take damage equal to half the total ATK those destroyed monsters had while face-up on the field.
